_note: The guider service for T2's FAU (docs/guider.md), on the computer the FAU camera is plugged into:
Hardware-shaped but locked: allow_hardware is false, so nothing is opened until it is true AND --hardware is given,
which needs JDE's approval (docs/guider.md, Commissioning). Addresses are 127.0.0.1 placeholders.
From minerva-control (sites/minerva/README.md has the table): fau_t2.ini -- ZWO ASI174 (the file's
MANUFACTURER = SBIG is stale), 0.265 arcsec/px, the fiber at (948, 626) (0-based pixels of the legacy FITS
frame: confirm with POST /locate before trusting it), legacy loop gains (Loop_params KPx/KIx, Deadband).
The FAU is on M3 port 1 (telescope_2.ini [PORT] FAU); 'port' names the calibration, not the port number.
The SX AO tip/tilt is NOT enabled: legacy never used it (fau_t2.ini USETIPTILT = False; imager_server_t2.ini
#AOINI) and it has never been commissioned. _tiptilt_uncommissioned is its legacy set-up (ao_t2.ini: PORT COM9,
9600 baud, XMIN..YMAX +/-500 steps): rename it to 'tiptilt' (and add an 'offload') only during commissioning.
_legacy_seed_calibrations (NOT loaded): the mount's matrix from the plate scale at PA 0, and the AO's from
ao_t2.ini as the pre-2019 legacy code used it (PLATESCALE = 40 steps per arcsec, so 0.025 arcsec/step;
ROTOFFSET 45) via calibration.from_sx_legacy(0.025, 45, 0.265). Both are unverified starting points to
compare with POST /calibrate; README.md lists the conflicting alternatives.
